documents_expected.why: call page with the application guidelines

eligibility.rule: Local governments, nonprofit community groups or public schools
eligibility.quote: Any local government, non-profit community group, or public school can apply for a tree-planting grant.

eligibility.rule: Tree planting in one of the listed categories
eligibility.quote: Your tree-planting project should align with one of the following tree conservation categories:
Note, arboretum type planting is not supported.
Note, tree give away requests will not be accepted.

eligibility.rule: Street tree projects involve the homeowners along the street
eligibility.quote: Homeowners living along the focal street must be involved in the project.

eligibility.rule: School projects involve the student body
eligibility.quote: The student body must be involved in the project's implementation.

notes: North Carolina only (the programme serves NC communities). The 2027 application opens May 1, 2027; no deadline is published. The 'example application components' PDF shows past applications, not rules. The other PDF is a donation form.
